raw_html: [[Sneak Attack Bonus| Insightful Sneak Attack Bonus +6]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Sneak Attack Bonus| Insightful Sneak Attack Bonus +6]]''' : Provides a +6 Insightful modifier to your attack bonus and a +9 Insightful bonus to damage for any attack that would qualify as a Sneak Attack, even if the wielder is not a Rogue.
